description: This file defines server-side handlers for chat-related operations in a messaging system, including message sending, history retrieval, aborting chats, and injecting messages. It manages session transcripts, media attachments, and message routing within a chat infrastructure.

methods.name: resolveChatSendOriginatingRoute
methods.description: Determines the originating route for a chat message based on explicit origin, delivery context, session key, and client info.

methods.name: stripDisallowedChatControlChars
methods.description: Removes control characters (except tab, newline, carriage return, and printable ASCII) from a message string.

methods.name: sanitizeChatSendMessageInput
methods.description: Normalizes and sanitizes a chat message, ensuring it does not contain null bytes and control characters.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalChatSystemReceipt
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes optional system receipt string for chat messages.

methods.name: isAcpBridgeClient
methods.description: Checks if the client is an ACP bridge client based on specific client info.

methods.name: canInjectSystemProvenance
methods.description: Determines if the client has admin scope to inject system provenance fields.

methods.name: persistChatSendImages
methods.description: Saves inline images and offloaded media references to the media store, returning metadata.

methods.name: buildChatSendTranscriptMessage
methods.description: Constructs a transcript message object including media fields.

methods.name: resolveChatSendTranscriptMediaFields
methods.description: Extracts media paths and types from saved media for transcript inclusion.

methods.name: extractTranscriptUserText
methods.description: Extracts user-visible text from a transcript message content.

methods.name: rewriteChatSendUserTurnMediaPaths
methods.description: Updates media paths in a user's transcript message after media offloading.

methods.name: truncateChatHistoryText
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum number of characters, appending an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: sanitizeChatHistoryContentBlock
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates individual chat history content blocks.

methods.name: toFiniteNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if possible, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: sanitizeUsage
methods.description: Sanitizes usage metadata, keeping only finite numeric fields.

methods.name: sanitizeCost
methods.description: Sanitizes cost metadata, keeping only finite numeric fields.

methods.name: sanitizeChatHistoryMessage
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates a chat history message, removing sensitive or invalid fields.

methods.name: extractAssistantTextForSilentCheck
methods.description: Extracts visible assistant message text for silent token checks.

methods.name: sanitizeChatHistoryMessages
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of chat history messages, removing silent messages.

methods.name: buildOversizedHistoryPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder message indicating chat history was omitted due to size.

methods.name: replaceOversizedChatHistoryMessages
methods.description: Replaces oversized chat messages with placeholders.

methods.name: enforceChatHistoryFinalBudget
methods.description: Ensures chat history fits within maximum byte size, truncating or replacing with placeholders.

methods.name: resolveTranscriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for a session transcript based on session ID, store path, session file, or agent ID.

methods.name: ensureTranscriptFile
methods.description: Ensures the transcript file exists, creating it with header if necessary.

methods.name: transcriptHasIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Checks if a transcript file contains a message with a specific idempotency key.

methods.name: appendAssistantTranscriptMessage
methods.description: Appends an assistant message to the session transcript, creating the file if needed.

methods.name: collectSessionAbortPartials
methods.description: Collects partial snapshots of chat runs for session aborts.

methods.name: persistAbortedPartials
methods.description: Persists aborted chat run snapshots into transcripts.

methods.name: createChatAbortOps
methods.description: Creates an object with session abort operation functions for a given context.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalText
methods.description: Trims and normalizes optional string values.

methods.name: normalizeExplicitChatSendOrigin
methods.description: Validates and normalizes explicit chat message origin fields.

methods.name: resolveChatAbortRequester
methods.description: Determines the requester info for chat abort operations based on client info.

methods.name: canRequesterAbortChatRun
methods.description: Checks if a requester is authorized to abort a specific chat run.

methods.name: resolveAuthorizedRunIdsForSession
methods.description: Resolves which run IDs a requester is authorized to abort within a session.

methods.name: abortChatRunsForSessionKeyWithPartials
methods.description: Aborts chat runs for a session key, collecting partial snapshots and persisting aborts.

methods.name: nextChatSeq
methods.description: Generates the next sequence number for a chat run.

methods.name: broadcastChatFinal
methods.description: Broadcasts the final message for a chat run to all relevant clients.

methods.name: isBtwReplyPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if a reply payload is a 'btw' type with a question.

methods.name: broadcastSideResult
methods.description: Broadcasts a side result payload to clients.

methods.name: broadcastChatError
methods.description: Broadcasts an error message for a chat run.
